name: Hailo safety control
description: Read status, persistently disable Hailo, explicitly enable and verify supported hardware, or install an exact ready candidate while the safety block remains active. This workflow never changes Rust service lifecycle.

spec.question_description: Default is read-only status. Disable stops and masks only rust-health-hat.service, blocks autoload and explicit modprobe, updates all initramfs variants, and attempts a non-forced unload. Enable requires a present Hailo-8 device and leaves inference stopped and masked. Disabled install requires a ready candidate built for the running kernel and never loads or identifies hardware.

spec.question_name: Exact candidate version for disabled installation
spec.question_description: Required only for install_while_disabled. Enter an exact stable 4.x version already built locally for the running kernel, without a leading v. It must pass candidate hashes/source integrity checks and must be newer than the installed driver.
